summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Rolando Delgado, an American mixed martial artist born November 22, 1981. It states that he has fought for the Ultimate Fighting Championship and Bellator Fighting Championships. It also notes that he was a cast member on The Ultimate Fighter 8.
one_line: Rolando Delgado is an American mixed martial artist who fought for the UFC and Bellator and appeared on The Ultimate Fighter 8.
